headline: Prosecutors seek death penalty for Hasanul Haq Inu in appeal
summary: The prosecution has moved the Supreme Court to increase the 10-year sentence of the JaSaD President for crimes against humanity during the July 2024 uprising.
details: Prosecutors have appealed to the Supreme Court seeking the death penalty for Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal (JaSaD) President Hasanul Haq Inu. He is currently serving a 10-year prison sentence for crimes against humanity committed during the July 2024 mass uprising.
caption:
From 10 years to the death penalty: Prosecutors are now seeking the maximum punishment for JaSaD President Hasanul Haq Inu.

headline_marked: Man [[beaten to death over theft suspicion]] in Jessore
headline: Man beaten to death over theft suspicion in Jessore
summary: A man named Mizanur Rahman died after being lynched by a mob in Chougachha, Jessore, following allegations of attempting to steal cows.
details: A man identified as Mizanur Rahman was killed by a mob in Baghardari village of Swarupdah Union, Chougachha, Jessore.
The incident occurred early Monday morning around 3:00 AM at the residence of Idris Ali.
Local residents reported that several individuals entered the cow shed of the house, prompting the owner to shout for help.
Neighbors rushed to the scene and chased the suspects; while two managed to escape, Mizanur Rahman was caught and beaten by the angry crowd.
Police arrived and rescued him in a critically injured state, subsequently admitting him to the Upazila Health Complex.
Mizanur Rahman passed away on Monday morning while undergoing treatment at the health complex.
caption:

Neighbors rushed to the scene and chased the suspects; while two managed to escape, Mizanur Rahman was caught and beaten by the angry crowd.

Police arrived and rescued him in a critically injured state, subsequently admitting him to the Upazila Health Complex.

Mizanur Rahman passed away on Monday morning while undergoing treatment at the health complex.
